# SoraProgress

Determinate or indeterminate progress built on the native `<progress>` element.

|  |  |
| --- | --- |
| Category | feedback |
| Import | `import { SoraProgress } from '@your-scope/ui'` |
| Direct import | `import SoraProgress from '@your-scope/ui/components/SoraProgress'` |
| Source | [`packages/ui/src/components/feedback/SoraProgress.vue`](../../packages/ui/src/components/feedback/SoraProgress.vue) |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `value` | `number \| null` |  | Completed amount. `null`/omitted renders an indeterminate bar. |
| `max` | `number` | `100` |  |
| `label` | `string` |  | Visible label. Without it the bar is named by the translated "Progress". |
| `showValue` | `boolean` | `false` | Show the percentage next to the label. |
| `size` | `SoraSize` | `'md'` | Size. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |
| `color` | `SoraColor` | `'primary'` | Colour role. Where no default is listed, it falls back to the nearest `SoraProvider` `defaults`, then to `sora.config.ts`. |

## Attributes

The root `<div>`.

## Accessibility

- Native `<progress>`; omitting `value` makes it indeterminate.
- Named by the visible `label`, or by a translated default.
- `aria-valuetext` carries the locale-formatted percentage.

## Styling

- `.sora-progress`, `.sora-progress__bar`, `.sora-progress__label`, `.sora-progress__value`
- `data-size`, `data-color`

## Example

From the gallery ([`apps/gallery/src/demos/FeedbackDemos.vue`](../../apps/gallery/src/demos/FeedbackDemos.vue)), where it is type-checked and covered by the end-to-end tests. `t()` is the gallery's translation function; the state it binds is declared in that file.

```vue
<div class="grid max-w-md gap-4">
  <SoraProgress :value="progress" :label="t('demo.progress.upload')" show-value />
  <SoraProgress :label="t('demo.progress.prepare')" color="secondary" size="sm" />
  <SoraProgress :value="100" color="success" size="lg" />
  <SoraButton
    class="justify-self-start"
    size="sm"
    variant="outline"
    color="neutral"
    @click="progress = (progress + 12) % 112"
  >
    {{ t('demo.continue') }}
  </SoraButton>
</div>
```
